desc:
A sandbox game in the sea.

Gather wood to make a crafting bench, and unlock more items.
Click the Raft button to spawn a raft for fast travel.
Kill pigs and collect mushrooms for food.

Items in chests do not save!
Private servers currently *do not* save your world.

----- CONTROLS -----

E: Basic crafting
Q: Inventory
H: Find water
Z: Drop item
Click: attack or build

----- Recent updates -----

> Fixed build controls on mobile
> Added Glowberry
> Added rain
